items.title: Vince Giordano interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2007
items.q: it was really the Luis Russell Band but he fronted it

ctx.x: Or that you enjoy listening to.

I’m trying to think. You know I’ve bought a few and I think probably this one Henry “Red” Allen, it’s not the most recent thing but I keep going back to these different takes of the Henry “Red” Allen Orchestra that came together in the late twenties, it was really the Luis Russell Band but he fronted it and made these wonderful Victor sides. And there were so many takes, and I grew up with the LP version. And it’s a wonderful thing when you just hear one take and it’s in your mind, and then all of a sudden you…
Is the way those fellows played teachable do you think?
